request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail and soft natural daylight; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one detail changed. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 shows one closed spiral notebook with a blue cover on a light-gray table. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same notebook shape, position, spiral, pages, table, light and framing. Change ONLY the color of the cover: it is now bright RED instead of blue, plain. Nothing else changes.
